Definition: properly, an adult (as of full length); by implication, a man (only in the plural)
BiblicalUsage: 1) male, man; 1a) males, men; 1b) few men (in prose); 1b1) less emphasis on sex; 1c) men (poetic); 1c1) less emphasis on sex
